However, when it came to technique and performance, her demeanor is shifted. Nikita Teacher has high standards and does not hesitate to instill a sense of accountability. She  pushes her students to perfect every movement, her stern gaze reminding them that excellence requires hard work and dedication.
Her attention to detail is unmatched; every posture and hand gesture is meticulously explained and refined, ensuring that students truly grasp the art form.
Her choreography is nothing short of brilliant. Each piece she creates is a perfect blend of tradition and innovation, reflecting her deep love for dance. She nurtures her students' individual styles while pushing them to reach their full potential. Classes are challenging yet rewarding, and her encouragement fosters a supportive environment.
If you're serious about learning Bharatnatyam and want to work with someone who genuinely loves her profession, Nikita teacher is the perfect choice!
